courses.synopsis: The different shapes and adaptive designs in fish in relation to the aquatic environment. Natural environmental adaptation of fish migration, reproduction, feeding habits, salinity, temperature and life cycles. Modified environmental behaviour of fish to pressure, light, electrical field and noise. Biology including membranes mitochondria systems and intermembrane processes. Biochemistry of growth, maintenance and reproduction.
